version_scope: Official pages explicitly selected as Unreal Engine 5.6 documentation, read 2026-11-05. Mutable pages retain some UE4 wording; not a binary or source-code verification. Publication dates not confirmed.
original_analysis: One hypothetical wall decoration distinguishes source cuts, Source0/Destination1/active1 and Min128/default256/instance32. An unintended override and an intentional lower budget require different changes; neither successful regeneration nor correct channel number proves a valid final bake.
limits: Documented Static Mesh Editor LOD0 workflow for precomputed static lighting.
No assertion about arbitrary chart detection, fixed packing, rotation or UV output.
No blanket claim all overlapping islands are unfixable by repacking.
No exact-equality quality guarantee at actual resolution equal to Min, and no universal safe pixel margin.
No extension to all LODs, Nanite, GPU Lightmass, virtual lightmaps, importers or other engine versions.
